trello.name: Implement queue depth alerting for worker fleet
trello.desc: Create monitoring alerts for worker queue depth across all worker fleets, not just payments. Set warning threshold at 1,000 jobs and page threshold at 5,000 jobs, same thresholds for all fleets. Ensure alerts fire within ~1 minute of breach and route to on-call. Acceptance criteria: alerts exist in monitoring system for each worker fleet, thresholds are 1,000 warning / 5,000 page, test alert triggers correctly, and on-call receives notification. Owner: Kofi.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry storm and dead-letter queue
trello.desc: Update payment_worker.py _process_with_retry function to prevent retry storm. Implement exponential backoff with jitter instead of immediate retries, cap total retries, and on final failure route job to dead-letter queue at the back instead of re-enqueueing at front of main queue. Add tests that simulate card processor 503 responses to verify backoff behavior and DLQ routing. Acceptance criteria: no immediate back-to-back retries, backoff with jitter applied, failed jobs go to DLQ not front of queue, tests simulating 503s pass. Owner: Marta.

trello.name: Increase and isolate DB connection pools
trello.desc: Update DB connection pool configuration in one change. Increase pool size from default 20 to 100 as interim mitigation, and split worker and API connection pools so they are independent. Changes are in same config file. Validate under load that API remains available when workers pile up. Acceptance criteria: worker pool and API pool are separate, pool size is 100, API does not fail due to worker connection exhaustion in load test. Owner: Kofi.

trello.name: Refresh payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Update payment incident runbook. Replace old Kibana links (decommissioned March) with current logging links. Document the queue drain procedure improvised on Tuesday as official step-by-step instructions. Verify escalation phone numbers are current and remove numbers for staff who left last year. Acceptance criteria: runbook reviewed, all logging links valid, queue drain procedure documented, escalation list accurate and tested. Owner: Priya, confirm with Kofi.

trello.name: Automate status page incident creation
trello.desc: Integrate status page provider API with monitoring. When checkout error rate alert fires, automatically create an 'Investigating' incident on the status page with a template message, removing manual login and multi-screen steps. Initially wire to checkout error rate alert; design for later extension to other alerts. Acceptance criteria: incident auto-created within minutes of alert firing, template message used, manual update no longer required. Owner: Marta.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Lead creation of a controlled chaos test plan for secondary payment processor failover. Plan must cover staging validation first, then production execution during a low-traffic window, with clear success criteria, rollback plan, and communications. Draft plan for team review in two weeks; no execution until plan is approved. Acceptance criteria: written plan reviewed by team, includes staging + production steps, rollback plan, and approval obtained before any test runs. Owner: Kofi.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Upgrade Redis from EOL version 6.0 to 7.2. Address config rename and persistence defaults changes required by 7.2. Schedule via infra calendar with a proper change window, not a casual Friday deploy. Execute upgrade with rollback plan and validation. Acceptance criteria: Redis running 7.2, configuration migrated correctly, security fixes applied, no data loss, change completed in scheduled window. Owner: Kofi.
